name: Protein interactions (sample)
cypher: MATCH (p1:Protein)-[:INTERACTS_WITH]->(p2:Protein) RETURN p1.name, p2.name LIMIT 10

name: Pathway proteins via PARTICIPATES_IN
cypher: MATCH (prot:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(p:Pathway) WHERE p.name = 'Signal Transduction' RETURN prot.name LIMIT 10

name: Pathway by name
cypher: MATCH (p:Pathway) WHERE p.name CONTAINS 'Insulin' RETURN p.name

name: Protein by name
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.name = 'TP53' RETURN p.name

name: Largest pathways by protein count
cypher: MATCH (prot:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(p:Pathway) RETURN p.name, count(prot) AS proteins ORDER BY proteins DESC LIMIT 10

name: Most connected proteins (interaction hub)
cypher: MATCH (p1:Protein)-[:INTERACTS_WITH]->(p2:Protein) RETURN p1.name, count(p2) AS interactions ORDER BY interactions DESC LIMIT 10

name: Protein -> Pathway -> Sibling proteins
cypher: MATCH (p1:Protein)-[:INTERACTS_WITH]->(p2:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(pw:Pathway) WHERE p1.name = 'TP53' RETURN pw.name, p2.name LIMIT 10

name: GO term annotations for proteins
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(go:GOTerm) RETURN p.name, go.name LIMIT 10

name: Reactions catalyzed by a protein
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:CATALYZES]->(r:Reaction) RETURN p.name, r.name LIMIT 10

name: Protein complexes
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:COMPONENT_OF]->(c:Complex) RETURN p.name, c.name LIMIT 10

name: Pathway hierarchy (parent-child)
cypher: MATCH (child:Pathway)-[:CHILD_OF]->(parent:Pathway) RETURN child.name, parent.name LIMIT 10

name: Regulation targets
cypher: MATCH (a)-[:REGULATES]->(b) RETURN labels(a)[0] AS src_type, labels(b)[0] AS tgt_type LIMIT 10

name: Shared pathways between interacting proteins
cypher: MATCH (p1:Protein)-[:INTERACTS_WITH]->(p2:Protein) WHERE p1.name = 'TP53' WITH p2 LIMIT 1 MATCH (p2)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(pw:Pathway) RETURN p2.name, pw.name LIMIT 10

name: Proteins in immune system pathway
cypher: MATCH (prot:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(p:Pathway) WHERE p.name = 'Immune System' RETURN prot.name LIMIT 20

name: Protein interaction network depth 2
cypher: MATCH (p1:Protein)-[:INTERACTS_WITH]->(p2:Protein)-[:INTERACTS_WITH]->(p3:Protein) WHERE p1.name = 'EGFR' AND p1 <> p3 RETURN p2.name, p3.name LIMIT 10

name: Drug side effects (sample)
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect) RETURN d.name, se.name LIMIT 10

name: Drug-gene interactions (sample)
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene) RETURN d.name, g.name LIMIT 10

name: Drug indications (sample)
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_INDICATION]->(ind:Indication) RETURN d.name, ind.name LIMIT 10

name: Drug adverse events (sample)
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_ADVERSE_EVENT]->(ae:AdverseEvent) RETURN d.name, ae.name LIMIT 10

name: Drug adverse events with gene targets
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene) WITH d LIMIT 5 MATCH (d)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect) RETURN d.name, se.name LIMIT 10

name: Drugs with most side effects
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect) RETURN d.name, count(se) AS side_effects ORDER BY side_effects DESC LIMIT 10

name: Most common side effects
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect) RETURN se.name, count(d) AS drugs ORDER BY drugs DESC LIMIT 10

name: Drugs sharing a gene target
cypher: MATCH (d1:Drug)-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene)<-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]-(d2:Drug) WHERE d1.name < d2.name RETURN d1.name, d2.name, g.name LIMIT 10

name: Drugs for a specific indication
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_INDICATION]->(ind:Indication) WHERE ind.name CONTAINS 'Diabetes' RETURN d.name, ind.name LIMIT 10

name: Side effects shared between two drugs
cypher: MATCH (d1:Drug)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect)<-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]-(d2:Drug) WHERE d1.name = 'Pregabalin' AND d1 <> d2 RETURN d2.name, se.name LIMIT 10

name: Genes targeted by most drugs
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene) RETURN g.name, count(d) AS drugs ORDER BY drugs DESC LIMIT 10

name: Most common adverse events
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_ADVERSE_EVENT]->(ae:AdverseEvent) RETURN ae.name, count(d) AS drugs ORDER BY drugs DESC LIMIT 10

name: Drug with indications and side effects
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug {name: 'Bivalirudin'})-[:HAS_INDICATION]->(ind:Indication) WITH d, ind MATCH (d)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect) RETURN ind.name, se.name LIMIT 10

name: Drugs with both gene targets and adverse events
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene) WITH d, g LIMIT 50 MATCH (d)-[:HAS_ADVERSE_EVENT]->(ae:AdverseEvent) RETURN d.name, g.name, ae.name LIMIT 10

name: Cancer drug side effects
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_INDICATION]->(ind:Indication) WHERE ind.name CONTAINS 'Cancer' WITH d LIMIT 50 MATCH (d)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect) RETURN d.name, se.name LIMIT 10

name: Trial interventions (sample)
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:TESTS]->(i:Intervention) RETURN t.nct_id, i.name LIMIT 10

name: Trial adverse events (sample)
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:REPORTED]->(ae:AdverseEvent) RETURN t.nct_id, ae.term LIMIT 10

name: Trial sites (sample)
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:CONDUCTED_AT]->(s:Site) RETURN t.nct_id, s.name, s.country LIMIT 10

name: Trial outcomes (sample)
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:MEASURES]->(o:Outcome) RETURN t.nct_id, o.title LIMIT 10

name: Trial sponsors (sample)
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:SPONSORED_BY]->(sp:Sponsor) RETURN t.nct_id, sp.name LIMIT 10

name: Trial conditions (sample)
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:STUDIES]->(cond:Condition) RETURN t.nct_id, cond.name LIMIT 10

name: Trial arm groups
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:HAS_ARM]->(arm:ArmGroup) RETURN t.nct_id, arm.title LIMIT 10

name: Trials per country
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:CONDUCTED_AT]->(s:Site) RETURN s.country, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 15

name: Most common interventions
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:TESTS]->(i:Intervention) RETURN i.name, count(t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 15

name: Most common adverse events
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:REPORTED]->(ae:AdverseEvent) RETURN ae.term, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 15

name: Most studied conditions
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:STUDIES]->(cond:Condition) RETURN cond.name, count(t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 15

name: Top sponsors
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:SPONSORED_BY]->(sp:Sponsor) RETURN sp.name, count(t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 10

name: Interventions for cancer trials
cypher: MATCH (cond:Condition)<-[:STUDIES]-(t:ClinicalTrial) WHERE cond.name CONTAINS 'Cancer' WITH t LIMIT 5000 MATCH (t)-[:TESTS]->(i:Intervention) RETURN i.name, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 10

name: Adverse events for diabetes trials
cypher: MATCH (cond:Condition)<-[:STUDIES]-(t:ClinicalTrial) WHERE cond.name CONTAINS 'Diabetes' WITH t LIMIT 5000 MATCH (t)-[:REPORTED]->(ae:AdverseEvent) RETURN ae.term, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 10

name: Sites running the most trials
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:CONDUCTED_AT]->(s:Site) WHERE s.country = 'United States' RETURN s.name, count(t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 10

name: Condition -> Intervention -> AE chain
cypher: MATCH (cond:Condition)<-[:STUDIES]-(t:ClinicalTrial)-[:TESTS]->(i:Intervention) WHERE cond.name CONTAINS 'Hypertension' WITH t, i LIMIT 2000 MATCH (t)-[:REPORTED]->(ae:AdverseEvent) RETURN i.name, ae.term, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 10

name: Sponsors funding cancer research
cypher: MATCH (cond:Condition)<-[:STUDIES]-(t:ClinicalTrial) WHERE cond.name CONTAINS 'Cancer' WITH t LIMIT 5000 MATCH (t)-[:SPONSORED_BY]->(sp:Sponsor) RETURN sp.name, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 10

name: Trial publications
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:PUBLISHED_IN]->(pub:Publication) RETURN t.nct_id, pub.citation LIMIT 10

name: Multi-arm trials with adverse events
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:HAS_ARM]->(arm:ArmGroup) WITH t, count(arm) AS arms WHERE arms >= 4 WITH t, arms ORDER BY arms DESC LIMIT 100 MATCH (t)-[:REPORTED]->(ae:AdverseEvent) RETURN t.nct_id, arms, ae.term LIMIT 10

name: Trial primary completion year distribution
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial) WHERE t.primary_completion_date IS NOT NULL RETURN substring(t.primary_completion_date, 0, 4) AS year, count(t) AS trials ORDER BY year DESC LIMIT 10

name: Drug + Trial + Pathway federation (paper Section 3.5)
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect) WHERE se.name CONTAINS 'Gastrointestinal' WITH d, se LIMIT 100 MATCH (i:Intervention {name: d.name})<-[:TESTS]-(ct:ClinicalTrial) WHERE ct.phase CONTAINS '3' AND ct.condition CONTAINS 'Breast' WITH d, se, ct LIMIT 50 MATCH (d)-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene) MATCH (p:Protein {gene_name: g.gene_name})-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(pw:Pathway) RETURN d.name, se.name, ct.nct_id, pw.name, g.gene_name LIMIT 20

name: Drug -> Gene -> Protein bridge
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug) WHERE toLower(d.name) = 'metformin' WITH d LIMIT 1 MATCH (d)-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene) WITH g.gene_name AS gn MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.gene_name = gn RETURN gn, p.uniprot_id LIMIT 10

name: Trial -> Drug -> Gene pipeline
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:TESTS]->(i:Intervention) WHERE i.name CONTAINS 'Aspirin' WITH t LIMIT 5 MATCH (d:Drug) WHERE toLower(d.name) = 'aspirin' WITH t, d LIMIT 1 MATCH (d)-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene) RETURN t.nct_id, d.name, g.gene_name LIMIT 10

name: Drugs targeting kinases (DI + PW)
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene) WITH g.gene_name AS gn, d MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.gene_name = gn AND p.name IS NOT NULL AND p.name CONTAINS 'kinase' RETURN d.name, gn, p.name LIMIT 10

name: Drugs in cancer trials with pathway context
cypher: MATCH (cond:Condition)<-[:STUDIES]-(t:ClinicalTrial)-[:TESTS]->(i:Intervention) WHERE cond.name CONTAINS 'Cancer' WITH i LIMIT 50 MATCH (d:Drug) WHERE toLower(d.name) = toLower(i.name) WITH d LIMIT 20 MATCH (d)-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene) RETURN d.name, g.gene_name LIMIT 10
